items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally. Evidence: the security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown, not certification. Recommendation: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; permit only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after capacity and overlap clearance, provided it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and passes isolated validation, disclosure checks, rollback, and existing measurement boundaries. Do not claim security clearance or a clean bill of health.

Retain the canonical fleet security evidence matrix; do not create duplicate telemetry requests. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, incident response readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Reassess only when concrete retained artifacts or authorized metadata support a decision.
